title: Røde Luer anti-curfew gathering outside the Storting, Oslo (13 February)
organizer: Røde Luer – frihet fremfor frykt (attributed by one anonymous report; organizer archive labels Røde luer)
participants_original: Approximately 100, according to the prior Norway January S005 summary of an anonymous Tjen Folket Media submission.
threshold_50_evidence: The prior-unit article summary reports approximately 100 attendees, which points above the 50-person threshold. It is one uncorroborated, strongly partisan anonymous submission; no independently verified count or numerical bounds were found. Keep min/max null.

start_date.summary: The prior Norway January S005 summary of the Tjen Folket report dates the gathering to 13 February; the current organizer archive entry on 17 February thanks people who attended “last Saturday,” retrospectively confirming that date.

end_date.summary: No consulted evidence gives the physical end. The archive lists planned hours, which are not used as an observed ending; end remains unknown.

location.summary: The article summary locates the action in Oslo; the current organizer archive announcement places the planned gathering outside/at the Storting.

scope.summary: The evidence describes a local Oslo gathering; no multi-city or nationally organized event is established.

organizer.summary: The prior article summary attributes organization to Røde Luer – frihet fremfor frykt; the current archive labels the organizer Røde luer.

demands.summary: The article summary describes opposition to the proposed curfew; the archive describes an anti-lockdown/freedom gathering, a demand concerning Norwegian social restrictions/state policy.

participants_original.summary: Only the prior Norway January source-card summary of the anonymous report supplies an approximate attendance of 100; the February unit did not reread that article body.

participants_min.summary: No exact minimum can be derived from an approximate “around 100” report; left null.

participants_max.summary: No exact maximum can be derived from an approximate “around 100” report; left null.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: One anonymous partisan report estimates around 100; it indicates the threshold but remains uncorroborated and is not converted into exact numeric bounds.

protester_violence.summary: The saved article summary alleges a brief confrontation with counter-protesters but does not establish violence by Røde Luer protesters against the state; coded unknown.

state_response.summary: The one partisan report alleges that police arrested several anti-fascist counter-protesters after a brief confrontation; this is coded as arrests=yes with attribution and reliability caveat. It does not report arrests of Røde Luer attendees. The other six response fields remain unknown.

eligibility.summary: Current organizer retrospective confirms occurrence and a demand about restrictions; the sole attendance estimate indicates at least 50 but is uncorroborated, so inclusion is a proposal for coordinator review only.

coding_status.summary: Research candidate only; not an official Mass Mobilization record and not independently reviewed.

notes: Current body access was limited to the organizer archive S002. The turnout and arrest details come only from the prior-unit card for the strongly partisan anonymous Tjen Folket Media submission S001. Arrests refer to alleged counter-protesters, not the Røde Luer gathering participants. No crowd number is pooled across dates.
open_questions: Can an independent contemporaneous account verify the approximate attendance and alleged counter-protester arrests?
What was the actual physical end time?
Did police take any other event-specific action?

title: Røde Luer anti-lockdown gathering in Oslo (20 February)
location: Oslo, Norway; the preceding organizer announcement specified the Storting, while the retrospective did not restate the venue.
participants_original: No attendance estimate in the consulted organizer archive.
threshold_50_evidence: The 22 February archive entry retrospectively thanks attendees from the preceding Saturday, confirming a gathering on 20 February, but provides no number or qualitative magnitude; the 50-person threshold remains unknown.

start_date.summary: The 17 February archive entry announced a 20 February gathering; the 22 February entry thanks people who attended “last Saturday,” confirming the 20 February gathering.

end_date.summary: The archive gives planned hours, not an actual physical end; end remains unknown.

location.summary: The preceding announcement planned the gathering at/near the Storting in Oslo; the retrospective confirms attendance the preceding Saturday but does not restate the venue.

scope.summary: The organizer archive describes a local Oslo gathering, not a national multi-site action.

organizer.summary: The organizer archive labels the series organizer Røde luer.

demands.summary: The event announcement describes opposition to lockdown/social restrictions.

participants_original.summary: No event-specific attendance figure appears in the consulted archive entry.

participants_min.summary: No numeric lower bound is available; left null.

participants_max.summary: No numeric upper bound is available; left null.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Occurrence is retrospectively confirmed, but no crowd size or qualifying qualitative estimate is provided; threshold remains unknown.

protester_violence.summary: The archive provides no event-specific violence details; silence is not treated as proof of no violence.

state_response.summary: The archive provides no event-specific state-response details; all seven fields remain unknown rather than treating silence as inaction.

eligibility.summary: A public gathering directed at COVID restrictions is retrospectively confirmed, but the >=50 threshold is unestablished; pending threshold review.

coding_status.summary: Research candidate only; not an official Mass Mobilization record and not independently reviewed.

notes: A separate date-specific gathering: no attendance pooled from 13 February or neighboring weeks. Only the organizer archive body was read for this date.
open_questions: Did the gathering take place at the announced site?
What was the actual physical end time?
Were any state responses documented elsewhere?
